data.description:
## Observation
`make verify` on branch veery-verify-identity-perf (rebased on origin/main 9ddb035cf59, 2026-11-18 PST, host load average ~16): 1 failed, 21,400 passed. The failure is `tests/unit/test_model_classes.py::test_a_finished_gate_drive_releases_its_event_loop[raised]` with `assert <_UnixSelectorEventLoop running=False closed=True> is None`. The same 2 parametrized cases pass in isolation. The branch touches only identity-verification files; the test was added by 9ddb035cf59 (bug waxy-nonspheral-cutworm).

## Root cause (reproduced)
anyio's `WorkerThread` (anyio/_backends/_asyncio.py) stores `self.loop = root_task._loop`. When the root task finishes, `WorkerThread.stop` only enqueues a `None` sentinel; the worker thread then exits on its own schedule. The test calls `gc.collect()` right after its drive thread joins, without waiting for anyio's worker threads, so if a worker has not yet been scheduled to exit, its thread object still references the closed loop.

Scratch reproduction: wrapping `WorkerThread.run` so the thread lingers 0.5 s after the sentinel makes the loop survive `gc.collect()` (loop_alive=True). Joining every `WorkerThread` (and dropping the reference) before `gc.collect()` makes it collectable (loop_alive=False). With no delay it is collected. So the failure is a timing race in the test, not evidence that anyio>=4.15 regressed.

## Fix direction
In `_drive_on_fresh_thread`, after the drive thread joins, join the anyio worker threads it started (snapshot `threading.enumerate()` before and after, join the new ones, and do not keep a reference) before returning the weakref. Test-only; no config.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The test waits for the drive's anyio worker threads to exit before `gc.collect()`.
- [ ] A regression check that delays `WorkerThread` exit (as in the reproduction) still passes the test.
- [ ] `make verify` passes and the change lands through Gerrit.
data.title: test_a_finished_gate_drive_releases_its_event_loop[raised] races anyio's worker-thread exit and fails under host load
